story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price BHARTIARTL to move about ±4.5%, roughly 1,981 to 2,168. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 61% of the time.
Upside calls cost more than downside puts, which is unusual. Traders are paying up for a sharp move higher (this happens in squeezes and in stocks with a big pending event).
BHARTIARTL futures trade 7.2 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 4.0% a year, within its usual range for the past year.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 2,200 (+6.4% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 2,000 (-3.3%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.

iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 19.1%: 60th percentile of 1 year, 21st of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much BHARTIARTL has actually been moving: they price 19.1% a year while the last month realised 21.9%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -2.8 vol points, 39th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 61% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.
